connector.name: Appfigures
connector.registryDescription: Access your app analytics, ASO tools, and app market intelligence with Appfigures.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cli. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.appfigures, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: APPFIGURES_API_KEY
env.description: Appfigures personal access token. Optional; omit it to sign in with `af auth login` instead. Read more at https://help.appfigures.com/en/article/1chf6wf
